title: Microsoft offers to buy out a quarter of its workforce
gist: Microsoft is offering voluntary exit packages to roughly 60,000 employees (about a quarter of its workforce) at level 70 and below in the US, India, Canada and UK, its second voluntary reduction of 2026, amid cost management alongside heavy AI data-center spending. The move, announced days before earnings, mirrors Alphabet's repeated voluntary exit programs and signals voluntary exits becoming a routine workforce tool.
